|errata_history=This is the original printed text; the images are the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-D-youmaystartyourlanding-pre.gif]]) and the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-p2-56-You_May_Start_Your_Landing.png]]). The later errata version is [[You May Start Your Landing (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1, the current text).
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 8.2 release sheet (official text as of 14 September 2012; the slip [[:File:VB8-p2-56-You_May_Start_Your_Landing.png]] and the Players Committee card image [[:File:VB8-D-youmaystartyourlanding-pre.gif]] print it, with the [Virtual Block 2] icon before “Imperial Control”)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock8_2">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_2.pdf Virtual Block 8.2 release sheet] ("Official text as of September 14, 2012"; the surviving copy was re-made 18 October 2012). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022233130/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>: “If 5th Marker on table, deploy on table. During your control phase, opponent loses 1 Force for each marker site you control with an AT-AT (limit 1 unless [Virtual Block 2] Imperial Control on table). Once per game, may ▲ Walker Garrison and/or 3rd Marker. (Immune to Alter.)” The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013, Dark Side p. 33) prints this text again; that copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[You May Start Your Landing (V) (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[You May Start Your Landing (V) (Errata)]]): the PC website card list (Virtual Block 8 lists, shown there by 12 December 2012, the first archived capture after the 8.2 release, and still on 11 January 2013) prints “an AT-At” and “Walker Garrrison” (typos kept as published). PC-E1 text<ref name="cl-1282_3">Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212003733/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-12-12] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142925/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive); the same text in the VBlock8Name and VBlock8Rarity lists of 13 December 2012</ref>: “If 5th Marker on table, deploy on table. During your control phase, opponent loses 1 Force for each marker site you control with an AT-At (limit 1 unless [Virtual Block 2] Imperial Control on table). Once per game, may ▲ Walker Garrrison and/or 3rd Marker. (Immune to Alter.)” The card list drops icons; the icons here are those of the printed slip. Card-list differences are versions (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).
